name: io.github.mcneel/rhino-mcp-platform
title: Rhino MCP Platform
description: MCP bridge from Rhino 3D and Grasshopper for modelling, scripting and plugin development.

environmentVariables.name: RHINO_MCP_RHINO_EXE_8
environmentVariables.description: Advanced. Absolute path to a specific Rhino 8 to launch (Rhino.exe on Windows, or the Rhino 8.app bundle on macOS). Leave unset to use the installed Rhino 8.

environmentVariables.name: RHINO_MCP_RHINO_EXE_9
environmentVariables.description: Advanced. Absolute path to a specific Rhino 9 to launch. Also serves WIP tool calls. Leave unset to use the installed Rhino 9.

environmentVariables.name: RHINO_MCP_RHINO_EXE_WIP
environmentVariables.description: Advanced. Absolute path to a specific Rhino WIP to launch. Leave unset to use the installed Rhino WIP.
